cards.prompt: Мне нужно решить вопрос с банком.

cards.text: We've run out of milk. Can you grab some on your way home?
cards.tr: У нас закончилось молоко. Захватишь по дороге домой?

cards.text: I keep putting off the paperwork, but this weekend I'm going to sort it out once and for all.
cards.tr: Я всё откладываю бумажки, но в эти выходные разберусь с ними раз и навсегда.

n1.say: Hey! Long time no see. How's everything going?
n1.tr: Привет! Давно не виделись. Как дела?

choices.text: Hey! Good, thanks. We should catch up properly.

n2.say: Totally. By the way, we've run out of coffee again.
n2.tr: Точно. Кстати, у нас опять закончился кофе.

choices.text: Oh no. I'll pick some up on my way home.
Again? Let's come up with a system, like a shopping list.

n3.say: Good idea. Did you sort out that bank thing?
n3.tr: Хорошая идея. Ты разобрался(ась) с банком?

choices.text: Not yet, I keep putting it off. It's so stressful.
choices.feedback: Честно — и phrasal verb в деле 👌

choices.text: Yes, I finally figured it out last week.

n4.say: I get it. Want me to help you go through it this weekend?
n4.tr: Понимаю. Хочешь, помогу разобраться в выходные?

choices.text: That would be amazing. Honestly, I'm looking forward to finally finishing it.
Thanks, but I'll turn that down. I want to try on my own first.

n5.say: Deal. Let me know if you change your mind. And don't forget the coffee!
n5.tr: Договорились. Скажи, если передумаешь. И не забудь кофе!
